messages:
sarah_support: Hey team, escalating a stuck invoice for NimbusHealth. Customer says they were approved for Net 30 during procurement, but finance blocked the invoice for missing PO number and VAT mismatch. Invoice INV-2026-0551 is unpaid and it's blocking their Dedicated deployment.

alex_billing: Thanks — I see INV-2026-0551 in our system flagged: missing field `po_number` and tax_id mismatch (customer provided VRN 12345-AB but our AP portal shows 12345-AC). Bounced back in our connector at 2026-03-02T14:12Z.

maria_finance: We also got a charge decline on the card on file on 2026-02-28 (decline code 05). Customer asked to switch to Net 60 while they complete PO; sales said Net 30 was negotiated. Need approval from finance or legal to temporarily allow Net 60.

liam_sales: NimbusHealth (account nimbus-987) said procurement requires a PO before payment. They were trying to issue PO-9932 but it hasn't propagated. Sales confirms original contract signed with Net 30. Customer asked for a 30-day extension to submit PO.

sarah_support: Customer is asking for provisional access to Dedicated while PO is pending. They're willing to provide a letter of intent and ACH/payment schedule. Can finance approve provisional provisioning with a temporary hold/credit? They need it for a pilot starting Monday.

maria_finance: We can consider a provisional allowance but need: signed SOW, email from procurement confirming PO in process, and VAT/tax docs to clear tax_id. Also need a credit hold note in billing. Requesting legal sign-off for contractual risk.

nathan_account_manager: I can get the procurement email and SOW by EOD. Quick question: is the VAT mismatch blocking invoice validation or the payment processor?

alex_billing: Both. Our invoice ingestion validates tax_id against billing profile; mismatch blocks invoice finalization and also prevents ACH tokenization. If we force-accept the invoice there's higher fraud risk per policy.

sarah_support: Customer also reported they didn't receive webhook confirmation when they uploaded their PO via the portal — they saw a 500 from our /billing/po endpoint. They pasted the log:```POST /billing/po 500 Internal Server Error
payload: {"account":"nimbus-987","po":"PO-9932"}
stack: TypeError: Cannot read property 'trim' of undefined at normalizePo (/app/billing/validate.js:48:22)```

alex_billing: Oof. That explains PO not appearing. Create case for eng-infra to patch the validation bug. For now, we can manually ingest PO-9932 if we get a screenshot/email.

maria_finance: Manual ingest is ok but still need VAT/tax proof to reconcile. If they provide a signed PO and vendor VAT certificate, we can grant provisional access for up to 14 days with ledger note. Approvals: finance + legal.

liam_sales: I'll collect the PO screenshot and procurement email. Also pushing for temporary access until legal answers. Customer offered to prepay first month as a compromise.

sarah_support: Customer asks about fees if we enable access and later revert due to non-payment. Please confirm whether we can apply a conditional hold or enable throttled Dedicated instance.

alex_billing: We can enable a limited-capacity Dedicated pool on a trial tariff and require pre-authorization for first invoice. If finance ok, we'll create a provisional billing agreement and attach to the account.

maria_finance: Approving provisional small pool if prepay of first month is received and PO/docs expected within 14 days. If not received, billing will suspend and standard collection policy applies. Legal to confirm wording today.

finance-bot: NOTE: Created billing ticket BIL-7642 for manual PO ingest and provisional access. Assigned to alex_billing and maria_finance. SLA 48h.

nathan_account_manager: I'll upload procurement email and SOW to the ticket and DM legal. Also confirming customer asked about moving to Net 60 permanently — legal flagged that as a contract amendment and requires exec sign-off.

sarah_support: Thank you. Final asks from us to finance/legal: (1) Temporary provisioning policy for blocked invoices, (2) manual PO ingest path and audit trail, (3) confirmation on whether Net 60 request needs exec approval or can be handled by finance for this account.

maria_finance: We'll draft an addendum template if execs approve Net 60. For this pilot, finance can approve provisional provisioning with prepay + docs. Will update BIL-7642 when legal responds.

liam_sales: Customer happy to prepay. I'll ask them to submit proof and the screenshot of the portal error so eng can triage.

sarah_support: Perfect. Closing the loop with Nimbus once docs submitted. If anyone needs me to ping the customer, I can. :thumbsup:

alex_billing: One more thing — we should add a small UX change: surface clearer validation errors on /billing/po so customers get a field-level error rather than a 500. I'll raise an eng-repo issue.

sarah_support: Cheers — thanks everyone.
